scope: Final v7 production build with capture-phase drawer Escape/IME correction. All six profiles cover complete 26-link navigation, repeated keyboard/pointer reopening and focus return, accepted destinations, command search, route-lazy shell failures/focus, native availability inertness, footer entry and eight workspace routes. Separate from the complete 1,320-case initial invocation that found one drawer failure. No retries, timeout/assertion weakening or actual application/provider writes.
